snippet.title: TAMBOURINE - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
This is our upcoming game, TAMBOURINE. 

Steam Page LINK ⬇️⬇️⬇️‼️‼️  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4579480/TAMBOURINE/

It is a first-person survival horror game about exorcising an abandoned building by parrying and tormenting ghosts with the sound of an instrument, the tambourine.

Feel free to ask any questions in the comments!!

Follow us to stay updated on the project's development and support us 🦭 ❤️
